Aestivation.question: What is Aestivation? State of animal or plant dormancy in the summer.
Aestivation.fact: Aestivation (Latin: aestas (summer); also estivation in American English) is a state of animal or plant dormancy, similar to hibernation, although taking place in the summer rather than the winter.
